title: storage.notNull has ONE adopter in the whole framework — the stamping story for required-at-storage columns never happened, and control-plane drift audits pay for it
body: From cloud#1736's audit: all 8 relax_not_null findings on cloud's control DB were the same defect — columns whose DB NOT NULL predates declarations that never said storage.notNull. The plan's own suggested remedy ('ratify by declaring storage.notNull; os migrate meta stamps it') has effectively never been used: exactly one occurrence in the framework at the pin (plugin-sharing's sys-sharing-rule.object.ts). Decision needed: is storage.notNull the real vocabulary for required-at-storage? If yes, stamp the backlog where it is intended (audit names sys_invitation/sys_member/sys_team.organization_id as candidates needing a cloud-side posture decision per ADR-0057 addendum); if no, retire the attribute so plans stop suggesting a remedy nobody uses. Note: cloud applied the 8 relaxes on production 2026-08-29 (run 33247881206) — the DB constraints are gone; whatever this decides becomes declarations, not DDL archaeology.
